description: This file defines React UI components such as Card, Button, TextInput, Select, and Table, along with utility functions like 'cn' for class name merging. It serves as a component library for building user interfaces.

methods.name: cn
methods.description: Utility function to join class name fragments, filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: React functional component representing a styled container card.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: React component for the header section of a Card, with optional title and subtitle.

methods.name: CardBody
methods.description: React component for the body/content area of a Card.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: React component for a styled button with multiple variants (primary, secondary, ghost, danger).

methods.name: TextInput
methods.description: React component for an input field with label, hint, and error display.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: React component for a select dropdown with label, hint, and error display.

methods.name: Table
methods.description: React component rendering an accessible table with headers and optional caption.
